name: Prismatic Focusing Iris
tooltip:
Prismatic Focusing Iris
Item Level 72
Optional Crafting Reagent
+5 Recipe Difficulty

Provides the following property: Your spells and abilities have a chance to activate the Iris, firing a focused beam of light at your target and dealing (1 * 1102) Arcane damage every second for 4 sec.

Each unique gem color you have socketed empowers the Iris, causing it to deal 1% additional damage per.

Usable with: Midnight recipes for most unembellished equipment.

"Can be bought and sold on the Auction House."
Max Stack: 20
Sell Price: 13 20
